list.name: game
list.label: Game
list.query: Magic: The Gathering : magic,Pokémon : pokemon,One Piece : onepiece,Riftbound : riftbound

list.name: window
list.label: Window
list.description: 14/28/56 days measure the stored daily history. Cardmarket averages ranks the latest day by its trend against Cardmarket's 30-day average: it works from the first sync, but one sale can move it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  -- Windows of 14/28/56 days: the measures the sync computed from the stored history.
  SELECT r.id_product, r.price, r.gain_pct, r.r2, r.as_of, r.window_days,
         NULL::numeric AS avg30, NULL::numeric AS avg7, NULL::numeric AS avg1
  FROM rising r
  WHERE r.game = '$game' AND r.window_days = $window AND r.foil = $foil
    AND r.r2 >= 0.0 AND r.coverage >= 0.8 AND r.rising_steps >= 2 AND r.jump_share <= 0.5
  UNION ALL
  -- Cardmarket averages (window 0): the latest day alone, trend against Cardmarket's 30-day average.
  -- The 1-, 7- and 30-day averages have to rise in order, and gains over 300 % are taken for odd sales.
  SELECT a.id_product, a.price, (a.price / a.avg30 - 1)::float8, NULL, a.day, 0, a.avg30, a.avg7, a.avg1
  FROM (
    SELECT p.id_product, p.day,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.trend_foil ELSE p.trend END AS price,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg30_foil ELSE p.avg30 END AS avg30,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg7_foil ELSE p.avg7 END AS avg7,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg1_foil ELSE p.avg1 END AS avg1
    FROM price p
    WHERE $window = 0 AND p.game = '$game' AND p.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM price WHERE game = '$game')
  ) a
  WHERE a.avg30 > 0 AND a.avg7 >= a.avg30 AND a.avg1 >= a.avg7 AND a.price >= a.avg7 AND a.price <= 4 * a.avg30
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Rising now"
FROM r
WHERE r.price >= coalesce(nullif(replace(trim('$min_price'), ',', '.'), '')::numeric, 5)
  AND r.gain_pct >= coalesce(nullif(replace(trim('$min_gain'), ',', '.'), '')::numeric, 15) / 100.0

SELECT count(*) AS "Cards tracked daily"
FROM price
WHERE game = '$game' AND day = (SELECT max(day) FROM price WHERE game = '$game')

SELECT coalesce(to_char(min(day), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '—') AS "History since"
FROM price
WHERE game = '$game'

SELECT coalesce(
  (SELECT to_char(finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' · ' || status
   FROM import_run WHERE game = '$game' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'never') AS "Last import"

WITH r AS (
  -- Windows of 14/28/56 days: the measures the sync computed from the stored history.
  SELECT r.id_product, r.price, r.gain_pct, r.r2, r.as_of, r.window_days,
         NULL::numeric AS avg30, NULL::numeric AS avg7, NULL::numeric AS avg1
  FROM rising r
  WHERE r.game = '$game' AND r.window_days = $window AND r.foil = $foil
    AND r.r2 >= 0.0 AND r.coverage >= 0.8 AND r.rising_steps >= 2 AND r.jump_share <= 0.5
  UNION ALL
  -- Cardmarket averages (window 0): the latest day alone, trend against Cardmarket's 30-day average.
  -- The 1-, 7- and 30-day averages have to rise in order, and gains over 300 % are taken for odd sales.
  SELECT a.id_product, a.price, (a.price / a.avg30 - 1)::float8, NULL, a.day, 0, a.avg30, a.avg7, a.avg1
  FROM (
    SELECT p.id_product, p.day,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.trend_foil ELSE p.trend END AS price,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg30_foil ELSE p.avg30 END AS avg30,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg7_foil ELSE p.avg7 END AS avg7,
           CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.avg1_foil ELSE p.avg1 END AS avg1
    FROM price p
    WHERE $window = 0 AND p.game = '$game' AND p.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM price WHERE game = '$game')
  ) a
  WHERE a.avg30 > 0 AND a.avg7 >= a.avg30 AND a.avg1 >= a.avg7 AND a.price >= a.avg7 AND a.price <= 4 * a.avg30
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.gain_pct DESC, c.name) AS "#",
  c.name AS "Card",
  coalesce(e.name, '#' || c.id_expansion) AS "Expansion",
  r.price AS "Price",
  r.gain_pct AS "Gain",
  r.r2 AS "R²",
  h.spark AS "Trend",
  r.id_product
FROM r
JOIN card c ON c.game = '$game' AND c.id_product = r.id_product
LEFT JOIN expansion e ON e.game = c.game AND e.id_expansion = c.id_expansion
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT string_agg(ch, '' ORDER BY b) AS spark
  FROM (
    SELECT b, substr('▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█',
      1 + coalesce(floor(7.999 * (v - min(v) OVER ()) / nullif(max(v) OVER () - min(v) OVER (), 0)), 0)::int, 1) AS ch
    FROM (
      SELECT width_bucket(p.day - (r.as_of - r.window_days + 1), 0, r.window_days, 14) AS b,
             avg(CASE WHEN $foil THEN p.trend_foil ELSE p.trend END) AS v
      FROM price p
      WHERE r.window_days > 0 AND p.game = '$game' AND p.id_product = r.id_product
        AND p.day > r.as_of - r.window_days AND p.day <= r.as_of
      GROUP BY 1
      UNION ALL
      -- Cardmarket averages: 30 days, 7 days, 1 day, trend.
      SELECT s.b, s.v FROM (VALUES (1, r.avg30), (2, r.avg7), (3, r.avg1), (4, r.price)) s (b, v)
      WHERE r.window_days = 0
    ) buckets
    WHERE v IS NOT NULL
  ) chars
) h ON true
WHERE r.price >= coalesce(nullif(replace(trim('$min_price'), ',', '.'), '')::numeric, 5)
  AND r.gain_pct >= coalesce(nullif(replace(trim('$min_gain'), ',', '.'), '')::numeric, 15) / 100.0
ORDER BY r.gain_pct DESC, c.name
LIMIT 500
